title.narrative: Strengthening the roles of NGOs for sustainable development and climate action at the local level for participatory and inclusive sustainable development

description.narrative: The action aims at strengthening the role of CSOs as governance and development actors in Egypt via establishing a policy dialogue between the CSOs and the different parties that are concerned with the sustainable development and climate action and actively contribute to local governance processes. The action also aims at engaging citizens, informal groups in the selected communities in decision making via involving them in assessing the sustainable development needs of their communities.
